title: Trust domain table says everything in ssh.local is agent-signed; five sources now publish there unsigned
description:
SPEC-HIRE.md:143 reads '| ssh.local | SSH agent (locally trusted) | Agent-signed challenge; weak assurance |'. A relying party reading that row concludes spiffe://ssh.local/unix/1000 was backed by an agent-signed challenge. It was backed by getuid().

Pre-existing drift widened by one source: gpg.rs:87, did_key.rs:69, oidc.rs:79 and fido2.rs:90 already publish into SshLocal despite the pgp.local and personal.{user} rows existing. The token itself is honest (service.rs:355 emits sources:["unix"]), so the damage is confined to the spec.

Fix the authority column to say 'local machine' rather than naming the agent.
